profile_text.body:
Writer is a for-profit startup founded in 2020 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company describes itself as an enterprise AI agent platform built to help teams execute and scale on-brand, compliant work, and says it is trusted by Fortune 500 companies. It emphasizes a five-year track record of AI research and large language model innovation, with a stated focus on transparency, reliability, and control for enterprise customers.

The company's primary product, Writer.com, sits in the writing and editing category and encompasses enterprise writing AI, brand governance, style guide enforcement, hallucination detection, and its proprietary PALMYRA language models. Writer also offers certifications, self-paced courses, and video tutorials covering generative AI basics through custom AI agent development, and it markets prebuilt AI workflows aimed at enterprise marketing teams and Global 2000 marketing leaders.

The site's held facts note an associated MCP server entry for DocuWriter.ai, described as a tool to generate, search, and manage codebase documentation with 72 tools including an Autopilot feature, though this appears as a third-party integration in the registry rather than a Writer-owned product. No litigation or SEC filings are recorded for the company.
